bounded_object: specific approved protocol, amendment, or risk determination
participant_classes: research lead; biosafety officer; named reviewers
minimum_receipt: protocol identifier; determination; date; roles; public or releasable receipt
forbidden_inference: Approval proves the recorded decision, not safe execution or later compliance.

bounded_object: specific IBC, IRE, DURC, PEPP, or equivalent meeting/determination
minimum_receipt: agenda or determination; authority; conflicts; date; decision
forbidden_inference: Committee membership does not prove knowledge of every activity or effective veto.

bounded_object: specific award, supplement, pause, termination, or condition
minimum_receipt: award notice; terms; dates; risk conditions
forbidden_inference: Funding does not prove operational control or endorsement of every method.

bounded_object: specific MTA, shipment, accession, release, destruction, or custody event
minimum_receipt: identifier; material class at safe abstraction; dates; custody receipt
forbidden_inference: Custody evidence does not establish misuse, intent, or unsafe handling.

bounded_object: specific provider order or escalated customer/sequence review
participant_classes: provider decision actors; verified customer representatives
minimum_receipt: order-class receipt; review outcome; date; policy version
forbidden_inference: A flag is not proof of malicious intent; sensitive sequence content is never public.

bounded_object: specific service run, contract, access grant, or control decision
minimum_receipt: contract or public service record; date; control terms
forbidden_inference: Service access does not prove hazardous use.

surface_type: AI model or computational biology access
bounded_object: specific model release, access programme, evaluation, restriction, or incident
minimum_receipt: version; access terms; evaluation receipt; dates
forbidden_inference: Capability evaluation does not prove real-world execution.

surface_type: Publication, preprint, or repository risk review
bounded_object: specific manuscript, dataset, code release, editorial decision, or staged disclosure
participant_classes: authors; editors; reviewers where public; repository officials
minimum_receipt: decision record; policy version; dates; disclosure boundaries
forbidden_inference: Publication does not prove misuse; undisclosed peer reviewers are not inferred.

bounded_object: specific registration, inspection, finding, corrective action, or closure
forbidden_inference: Registration or inspection is not a guarantee of compliance outside the examined scope.

bounded_object: specific BWC CBM, JEE, peer review, workshop output, or national report
minimum_receipt: submission or report; scope; dates; limitations
forbidden_inference: Voluntary reporting does not establish completeness or compliance.

surface_type: Incident, near miss, or outbreak investigation
bounded_object: specific reported exposure, release, anomaly, investigation, or after-action review
minimum_receipt: official incident record; time line; evidence limits; disposition
forbidden_inference: An investigation is not attribution unless the record supports attribution.

bounded_object: specific exercise, activation, procurement, manufacturing tranche, or response mission
participant_classes: public-health, logistics, laboratory, medical and government actors
minimum_receipt: exercise or operation record; roles; dates; after-action findings
forbidden_inference: Participation does not prove readiness beyond the tested scenario.

surface_type: Certification, audit, insurance, or standards assessment
bounded_object: specific certification, audit, accreditation, underwriting, or corrective action
participant_classes: auditors; accredited officials; accountable facility actors
forbidden_inference: Certification covers the audited scope and period only.

bounded_object: specific exposure monitoring, compensation, medical care, grievance, hearing, or remedy
minimum_receipt: public decision or privacy-preserving aggregate receipt
forbidden_inference: Affected-person data are minimized; absence of public record is not absence of injury.
